metadata.clarification: Diverges from Kwak et al. (2021) by embedding whole propositions and whole documents rather than aggregating word-level dictionary counts.
metadata.primary_operator: F_k(x) = cos(e(x), e(h_A)) - cos(e(x), e(h_B)) [FrameAxis cosine difference]
metadata.sensitivity_operator: P_k(x) = cos(e(x), e(h_A) - e(h_B)) = <e(x), v_k> / (||e(x)||_2 ||v_k||_2) = F_k(x) / ||v_k||_2 where ||e(x)||_2 = 1 [Normalized vector projection]
metadata.normalization_note: All document and hypothesis representations are L2-normalized unit vectors. P_k is a strictly positive scalar scaling (1/||v_k||_2) of F_k per axis; under column standardization, Z(P) and Z(F) are mathematically identical.
metadata.benchmark_status: Diagnostic benchmark (N=4 per category, 16 total minimal pairs) assessing directional responsiveness rather than a powered inferential test.
metadata.description: Matched FrameAxis-style baseline vs NLI across Prospective N=120, Clean N=83, Controlled N=60, and Clean Ukraine N=60 under both raw covariance and column-standardized correlation matrices.
